title: BundleCrash-Patch
description: BundleCrashPatch is a lightweight anti-exploit plugin for Minecraft servers that prevents server crashing from the bundles packet conflict .
body:
# 🛡️ BundleCrashPatch - Anti-Bundle Exploit Patch

**BundleCrashPatch** is a lightweight anti-crash plugin for Minecraft servers that prevents bundle crash by filtering out the bundle packets which causes the 
error which leads to crash.

this plugin fixes the crash caused by the bundle packet conflict in 1.21.4 in the simplest way possible.

uses protocollib to intercept and sanitize client packets before they can affect server performance or stability.
